stories.title: Israel expels Dutch representatives from Gaza coordination center
stories.summary: Israel expelled Dutch representatives from a Gaza coordination centre after the Netherlands announced its decision to ban imports from illegal Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territories. Israeli foreign minister Gideon Saar said in a post on X that the representatives will be "expelled immediately" from the International Support Center for Gaza in Kiryat Gat, and were asked to leave Israel within a week. Saar said the decision, approved by prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu, was in response to what he called a "series of anti-Israel moves" by the Dutch government. "The anti-Israel policy of the Dutch government is accompanied by an unprecedented wave of antisemitism and boycotts in that country," he added. "Our message is clear: Whoever acts against Israel will have no foothold in the region. Israel will not allow steps against it without a response."

stories.title: Chinese worker develops severe muscle breakdown after manager punishes her with 200 squats
stories.summary: A Chinese woman developed life-threatening muscle breakdown after her company forced her to perform 200 squats as punishment for unfinished work. The young woman, surnamed Yang, recently moved to Hangzhou in eastern China’s Zhejiang province and began her first job as a financial consultant at a loan assistance company in June. The role is essentially a tele-sales position. Her team manager, surnamed Zhang, required each team member to make 200 calls, invite one client, and secure one client...
